params.body:
Two follow-ups to typing beside the voice.

- **Agent notices in the shared conversation.** The bridge now checks the agents itself every eight seconds, whether or not a voice is on. "voice-4 is done (…)" and "voice-4 waits for your approval (…)" go into the open conversation as events, so the desk, the phone and the app all see them in the timeline. Before, only the device holding the voice saw them. Each live voice reads what it has not had yet from its own cursor (`/changes?conversation=`), and a voice that connects for the first time starts from that moment. Before, the first device to poll took a notice and the others missed it.
- **Typed instructions are labelled as typed.** `tell_agent` called from a written answer now tells the agent "Typed by the owner" instead of "Said by the owner, by voice". A typed instruction cannot have been misheard.

Checked: `node --test voice/*.test.mjs` (14 pass). On a second bridge: `/changes` answers with and without a conversation, and the watcher runs without errors. Not checked: a real agent finishing, which needs a herdr agent to change state.

Takes effect after a restart of `voice-bridge.service`.
params.title: Voice: agent notices in the shared conversation, typed instructions said as typed
